ceilingSources.residentMemoryBytes: rule: 2x the larger measured resident set (62046208 B over the recorded hosts), rounded up to a whole MiB; evidence runtime-budget.evidence/
ceilingSources.idleCpuPercent: rule: 1 percent absolute for an idle crate; measured at most 0.053 percent on the recorded hosts

status.note: The status call returns rightkit_process::ProcessUsage (resident and footprint bytes, cumulative CPU seconds, wake-up and disk-operation totals where the host reports them) beside the crate's own queue figures; the rates come from two calls (ProcessUsage::rates_since). Wake-ups are macOS only; disk operations are Windows and Linux only.

notes: Ceilings come from the recorded measurements by stated rules (ceilingSources); a ceiling left null names its reason below. wakeupsPerSecond left null: measured 13.4 and 9.4 per second: the watchdog polls every 250 ms and pings the main thread every 1 s (src/watchdog.rs install), on top of the Wry event loop; polling is a defect, not a budget. diskOpsPerSecond left null: no Windows measurement exists, and macOS exposes no per-process disk-operation counter.
